intro.name: Jacob Williams
intro.paragraph: I'm a full-stack developer who builds across the front end, the back end and mobile with React, Node.js, Java and React Native. I write a spec before I write code, and every change, AI-assisted or not, gets tested and reviewed before it ships.

technicalGroups.title: Frontend Engineering
technicalGroups.summary: Interfaces for web and mobile, built from reusable components that work on any screen.

skills.name: React
skills.description: Reusable components, hooks, Context and client-side routing.

skills.name: React Native / Expo
skills.description: Cross-platform mobile apps with file-based navigation.

skills.name: JavaScript ES6+
skills.description: Promises, async/await, array methods and ES modules.

skills.name: HTML & responsive CSS
skills.description: Semantic markup and mobile-first layouts for any screen size.

technicalGroups.title: Backend Engineering
technicalGroups.summary: Secure server logic and clean APIs that validate input and fail predictably.

skills.name: Node.js / Express
skills.description: RESTful routes, controllers and custom middleware.

skills.name: Java / Spring Boot
skills.description: Layered architecture, Spring Security and server-rendered views.

skills.name: Auth & sessions
skills.description: Token-based sessions, password hashing and role-based access.

skills.name: API design
skills.description: Clean endpoints, request validation and consistent error responses.

technicalGroups.title: Data
technicalGroups.summary: Relational and document databases, modeled first and secured at the data layer.

skills.name: SQL / MySQL
skills.description: Normalized schemas, joins and hand-written queries.

skills.name: Spring Data JPA / Hibernate
skills.description: Entity mapping and repository-based data access.

skills.name: MongoDB / Mongoose
skills.description: Flexible document models with schema validation.

skills.name: PostgreSQL / Supabase
skills.description: Hosted Postgres secured with row-level security policies.

technicalGroups.title: Development Workflow
technicalGroups.summary: The habits that get code from a branch to production safely.

skills.name: Git / GitHub
skills.description: Feature branches, pull requests and conventional commits.

skills.name: CI/CD
skills.description: Automated builds and deployments on every merge.

skills.name: Debugging
skills.description: Tracing issues from the browser to the server to the database.

skills.name: Environments
skills.description: Separate dev and production configs, with secrets kept out of code.

technicalGroups.title: AI-Assisted Engineering
technicalGroups.summary: AI speeds up the work, while specs and human review keep it correct.

skills.name: Specification & decomposition
skills.description: Clear specs and acceptance criteria before any code, with big goals broken into small, testable tasks.

skills.name: Claude Code
skills.description: Custom commands and skills that automate repeat workflows.

skills.name: Context engineering (CLAUDE.md)
skills.description: Project rules that keep AI output on-stack and on-standard.

skills.name: AI-assisted review & testing
skills.description: Every AI-generated change is reviewed and verified before it ships.

softSkills.name: Fast Learner
softSkills.description: I picked up four stacks in one program: MERN, Java + Spring Boot, React Native, and Supabase.

softSkills.name: Problem Solving
softSkills.description: I break bugs down step by step and test each piece, from API calls in Postman to unit tests in JUnit.

softSkills.name: Planning & Organization
softSkills.description: I write a spec before I write code, so every feature has clear goals and a clear finish line.

softSkills.name: Attention to Detail
softSkills.description: I lint, test and audit my work before I ship it, so small mistakes don't reach users.

softSkills.name: Clear Communication
softSkills.description: I document my work in plain words: READMEs, research notes and progress updates people can act on.

softSkills.name: Adaptability
softSkills.description: I switch between front end, back end and mobile without losing pace.
